description: This file defines a React component and related functions for inserting remote images into a lexical editor. It includes a dialog component for inputting image URLs and a plugin component that registers commands to handle inserting remote image nodes into the editor's document.

classes.name: InsertRemoteImageDialog
classes.description: A React component that renders a dialog for inputting an image URL and dispatching a command to insert a remote image into the editor.

classes.name: RemoteImagePlugin
classes.description: A React component that registers a command handler with the lexical editor to insert remote images when triggered.

methods.name: InsertRemoteImageDialog
methods.description: Component rendering a dialog for URL input and insertion of remote image.

methods.name: RemoteImagePlugin
methods.description: Component registering command to insert remote images into the editor.
